heading: INT. PLANETARY SURVEY SHIP, BRIDGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. PLANETARY SURVEY SHIP, BRIDGE - NIGHT
A curving window of stars.
Four stations, four lit consoles.
A klaxon starts mid-conversation.
CAPTAIN ELEANOR VOSKUIJLEN (50s, silver braid) stands at the center.
COMMANDER RAJIV ABERNATHY (40s) hunches at navigation.
LIEUTENANT SASHA TEMPLETON-OYELOWO (30s) works the comm.
ENSIGN BRODERICK "BROD" PAPADAKIS (20s, wide-eyed) mans the shield board.
Report!
units.name: VOSKUIJLEN

units.text: Asteroid field dead ahead, ma'am. Debris cloud--
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: Captain, I'm picking up a distress signal inside it--
units.name: TEMPLETON-OYELOWO

units.text: Shields at forty percent!
units.name: BROD

units.text: Divert power from the forward arrays.
units.name: VOSKUIJLEN

units.text: Diverting. Captain, the cloud is expanding faster than--
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: Signal's repeating. Says "last survivor, Aurora Station."
units.name: TEMPLETON-OYELOWO

units.text: Thirty percent! Twenty!
units.name: BROD

units.text: Hold your nerve, Ensign. Rajiv, can we thread it?
units.name: VOSKUIJLEN

units.text: Barely. Three seconds, and we'll clip the rim.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: Then clip it. Sasha, hail the survivor. Tell them we're coming.
units.name: VOSKUIJLEN

units.text: Aye, Captain.
units.name: TEMPLETON-OYELOWO

units.text: The ship shudders.
Alarms scream.
Then, one by one, they fall silent.
The window shows a calm field of drifting rock.
Brod sags over his board.
Shields... holding.
units.name: BROD

units.text: Good. Now find our survivor.
units.name: VOSKUIJLEN
